_note: Flags API runtime config (loaded from -config flag, default ./config.json; RESTART the server after editing). cors.enabled=false turns CORS OFF entirely (no headers, preflights fall through). allowed_origins ["*"] = open to every origin (default); use exact origins e.g. ["https://example.com"] to lock down. rate_limit.requests_per_minute=0 (or enabled=false) disables rate limiting. Explicit CLI flags (-cors, -ratelimit, -burst) and FLAGS_* env vars override this file. Unknown fields are ignored.
